inputs.name: loopRoot.input
inputs.description: An optional options object that may supply a root directory and a clock callback; loopRoot reads only its root field. If root is absent or nullish, loopRoot returns process.cwd().

inputs.name: loopPaths.root
inputs.description: The root directory used to build the loop storage paths. The helper joins it with specification/loops and the supplied loop segment, without creating directories.

inputs.name: loopPaths.loop
inputs.description: The loop name used as the final segment under specification/loops. This helper joins the string as given and does not validate its kebab-case form.

inputs.name: writeNewLoop.paths
inputs.description: The directory, state-file, trace-file, and relative trace paths for the new loop. writeNewLoop creates paths.dir recursively and writes the state at paths.state.

inputs.name: writeNewLoop.state
inputs.description: The loop state to serialize at paths.state after confirming that the state file does not already exist. Its name, goal, timestamps, and steps are required by the stored-state schema.

inputs.name: readLoop.path
inputs.description: The filesystem path of a stored loop JSON file to parse and validate. Missing files and schema mismatches become ExpectedCliError; malformed JSON and other read failures propagate.

inputs.name: assertLoopOpen.state
inputs.description: The stored loop state to check before continuing an operation that requires an open loop. It throws ExpectedCliError whenever state.closed is present.

inputs.name: writeLoop.path
inputs.description: The filesystem path to overwrite with serialized loop state. The function writes tab-indented JSON followed by a newline and does not validate the state first.

inputs.name: writeLoop.state
inputs.description: The loop state to serialize to the supplied path. JSON serialization must succeed, and the state is written with tab indentation and a trailing newline.

inputs.name: appendTrace.path
inputs.description: The trace file path that receives the event. The function appends one compact JSON value and a newline without creating the parent directory.

inputs.name: appendTrace.event
inputs.description: A JSON-serializable record appended as one compact JSON line to the trace file. The function does not validate event fields.

inputs.name: validateLoopId.value
inputs.description: The candidate loop identifier, trimmed and checked against lowercase ASCII letters and digits separated by single hyphens. Invalid values cause ExpectedCliError.

inputs.name: validateLoopId.label
inputs.description: The human-readable label inserted into the invalid-name error message. It does not affect the accepted identifier syntax.

inputs.name: validateRequiredText.value
inputs.description: Text to trim and require to be nonempty. Whitespace-only input causes ExpectedCliError; otherwise the trimmed text is returned.

inputs.name: validateRequiredText.label
inputs.description: The field label used in the error when the supplied text is empty after trimming. It does not change how text is validated.

inputs.name: timestamp.now
inputs.description: An optional callback value used as the clock when present; its returned string is used unchanged. Pass undefined to use new Date().toISOString().

inputs.name: isMissingFile.error
inputs.description: The value to inspect after a filesystem failure. It returns true only for an Error instance whose code property is exactly ENOENT.

outputs.name: loopRoot
outputs.description: The selected loop root directory. It returns input.root when that value is non-nullish, otherwise the current working directory.

outputs.name: loopPaths
outputs.description: The four paths used to store a loop: its directory, state JSON, trace file, and relative trace file. The helper computes paths only and performs no filesystem writes.

outputs.name: writeNewLoop
outputs.description: No value is resolved after the state file is created and written. The promise rejects if the loop already exists or filesystem or JSON serialization work fails.

outputs.name: readLoop
outputs.description: The validated state parsed from the loop JSON file. Stored state must contain nonempty name and goal strings, string timestamps, and a steps array; unknown keys are retained.

outputs.name: assertLoopOpen
outputs.description: No value is returned when the state has no closed field. A present closed field causes ExpectedCliError.

outputs.name: writeLoop
outputs.description: No value is resolved after tab-indented JSON and a trailing newline are written. The promise rejects if serialization or the filesystem write fails.

outputs.name: appendTrace
outputs.description: No value is resolved after one compact JSON event line is appended. The promise rejects if serialization or the filesystem append fails.

outputs.name: validateLoopId
outputs.description: The trimmed loop identifier when it matches lowercase kebab-case segments of ASCII letters and digits. Invalid values cause ExpectedCliError.

outputs.name: validateRequiredText
outputs.description: The supplied text after trimming surrounding whitespace. Empty trimmed text causes ExpectedCliError.

outputs.name: timestamp
outputs.description: The string returned by the supplied clock callback, or the current time from new Date().toISOString() when no callback is supplied. A supplied callback result is not reformatted.

outputs.name: isMissingFile
outputs.description: Whether the value is an Error instance with code exactly ENOENT. Other values, including plain objects with a code field, return false.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: An intentional CLI-facing failure raised by fail(...), including an existing loop, a missing or schema-invalid loop file, a closed loop, an invalid loop identifier, or empty required text.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A filesystem Error can propagate when a loop file cannot be read, created, written, or appended; a supplied clock callback Error also propagates unchanged.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: JSON.parse raises this when a loop file contains malformed JSON; readLoop does not convert that parse failure.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: JSON.stringify raises this when the state or event cannot be serialized, such as when it contains a cycle or a BigInt.
